description: Manual data corrections for missing or incorrect SFMTA data. These overrides are applied during ingestion to augment the official datasets.
traceability: All applied overrides are marked with 'source': 'manual_override' in the database
notes: Pattern identified: Some CNNs have street cleaning data for only L or R side, missing the opposite side
19th St has same CNN (961000) for both L (2701-2799) and R (2700-2798) sides
When one side has data but opposite is missing, it likely needs manual verification
All overrides must be physically verified on-site before being added to this file
Each override includes verification date and verifier for accountability
CRITICAL: Stanyan St is incorrectly labeled as 'STANYAN BLVD' for 3 CNN segments (12076000, 12077000, 12078000) in SFMTA Active Streets dataset
This causes meter matching failures because meters reference 'STANYAN ST' but these segments are labeled 'STANYAN BLVD'

overrides.reason: Missing from SFMTA street cleaning schedules dataset - physically verified on-site. CNN has L side data but R side is missing.
overrides.notes: This CNN also serves 19th St L 2701-2799 which has street cleaning data. R side was missing and manually verified.
overrides.documentation: See Issue #006 in DATA_QUALITY_LOG.md and Issue #1 in DATA_QUALITY_ISSUES.md
